source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Security' (PDF 19-20): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network security computer networks ko protect karne (bachane) ke liye istemal hoti hai. Yeh data ko unauthorized access (baghair ijazat pohanch) se mehfooz rakhti hai. Security data loss (data zaya hone) aur damage (nuqsan) se bachati hai. Rozana bohat se users networks se jurte hain. Security ke baghair networks unsafe (ghair mehfooz) ho jate hain. Network security mukhtalif tools aur rules (qaide) istemal karti hai. Yeh gharon aur organizations (idaron) ke liye zaroori hai. Network security personal (zaati) aur ahem maloomat ko bachati hai. Yeh hackers ko network mein aane se rokti hai. Security data ko private (raaz mein) aur mehfooz rakhti hai. Yeh devices ko malware (nuqsan deh software) se bhi bachati hai. Secure networks baghair rukawat smoothly chalte hain. Har network ko basic security measures (bunyadi hifazati iqdamat) chahiye.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Baat karein ke security hassas (sensitive) data, jaise hospital mein mareezon ke CT scans, ki hifazat kaise karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Network security kin cheezon se bachati hai? Teen batayein.
blocks.explanation: Baghair ijazat pohanch, hackers, malware (aur data ke zaya hone aur nuqsan) se.

items: Network security: data aur devices ko baghair ijazat pohanch, hackers aur malware se bachati hai; har network ko chahiye.
